title: OneMind Event Envelope
description: Versioned wrapper for every message on the OneMind NATS bus. All services, agents, bridges, and the Flutter UI speak this envelope. Consumers MUST tolerate unknown fields (additionalProperties: true) per forward-compat doctrine.

v.description: Schema version. Start at 1. Consumers pin a minimum v and tolerate unknowns. Breaking changes bump v and ship a migration note.

ts.description: Event timestamp — RFC3339 / ISO8601 with millisecond precision (e.g. '2026-06-10T14:30:00.123Z').

type.description: Dotted event type that mirrors the NATS subject grammar (e.g. 'evt.task.issue.created', 'tel.barn-pi-1.soil.moisture').

source.description: Actor ID that emitted this event (e.g. 'agent.legacy', 'node.barn-pi-1', 'device.go2-dog'). Matches the actor identity model.

subject.description: The NATS subject this envelope was published on. May differ from 'type' when the subject carries dynamic tokens (e.g. task IDs).

data.description: Typed payload. Schema varies by event type; the envelope is the wrapper, not the payload schema. Consumers parse this according to the 'type' field.

corr.description: Correlation ID — groups related events across a workflow or request chain. Propagate from triggering event.

causation.description: Causation ID — the 'id' of the parent event that caused this one. Enables event lineage graphs.

trace.description: Distributed trace ID — for integration with OpenTelemetry / Jaeger trace propagation.
